scenario: LTAC.3.6: an `after` whose body is a literal log message, on a rule with an Int key, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` cannot observe whether a `$CaptureBindings_<rule>_after_<N>` schema is emitted, which is what LTAC.3.6 decides (not emitted). The clause's tie to this vector is recorded as a gap until an observable vector exists.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule ping:
    Trig t where t.v > 0
->
    log info "fired"
    after 10_s:
        log info "done"
